scope: Release AOT simulator and emulator layout stress. CPU, RSS and PSS describe the whole process.

workload.update: Each app frame callback alternates the first child shape width between 8 and 10 logical units.
workload.control: Only the BenchCell Row call is replaced with centered HStack or Compose Row at the same gap. Fixture cells contain shapes.

platforms.ios: iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator, iOS 27.0, arm64; CADisplayLink target 60 Hz
platforms.android: emulator-5554, Android 12 API 31; 1080 x 2340; ART speed compilation after each install; gfxinfo last retained frame records

iosGeometryCheck.result: Dimensions and rendered child positions match the original helper in all cases. Child color probes detect leaking root fill or text alignment.
